title: Media Web Client Foundation
problem: Nako needs a first-party browser Media Web client for local media browsing and playback through the Public Client API without turning Admin Web into the player surface.
gates: cd apps/admin-web && npm run check && npm run test && npm run build

evidence.summary: Opened the Media Web foundation lane for local-media-first browser browsing/playback through Public Client API after identity/access contract closeout.

Audited Public Client OpenAPI and TypeScript SDK readiness; recorded ready route coverage and gaps for current principal/session summary, library-scoped item browse, Recently Added, and browser playback auth transport.

Added the shared Admin/Media frontend surface boundary inside apps/admin-web with symmetric switchers, Media connect shell, fixture/live Public Client SDK data source, focused tests, package validation, and browser smoke.

Added Media Libraries, Media Library detail, URL-owned search, and Media Item detail routes against Public Client SDK methods, with fixture/live data-source coverage, redaction tests, and browser smoke.

Added Source/Version Picker, playback decision preview, safe watch shell, and User Playback State watched/unwatched writes through the shared Media surface, while keeping real browser stream playback gated on the auth transport follow-on.

continue_policy.notes: MWF-060 should close the lane after final evidence review. Keep the real browser media element split to the playback auth transport follow-on; do not reopen this lane for Management Context Links, credential/session UX, Tauri/native playback, or recommendations.
